title: Number of Limit Cycles for Planar Systems with Invariant Algebraic Curves
claim: Quadratic systems with an invariant straight line have at most one limit cycle, which is hyperbolic
scope_read: Introduction and relevant reference list; original uniqueness proofs not rederived
reference: Coll and Llibre, Limit cycles for a quadratic system with an invariant straight line and some evolution of phase portraits, Colloquia Mathematica Societatis Janos Bolyai53,111–123(1988)
role: Imported classical theorem, not a newly proved global quadratic bound
